Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

December 6th 1918

Sir,
The coffin containing the remains of the late General Tsai Oo arrived from Japan at 10 a.m. 5th inst and the cortege passed through the Settlement to the Szecheun Guild in Chapel. General Loo Yoong Ziang 盧永祥 of Woosung, the Shanghai Taoyin, the staff officers of the Arsenal, the interpreters of the Bureau of Foreign Affairs, 56 American marines , several Chinese soldiers and pupils from various schools were amongst those present at the funeral. Tang Shao Yi 唐紹儀 'Poh Yung Wei 柏文蔚 Tsai Nyou Bai 蔡元培 Koo Nan Kong 顧乃庚 Han Hwei 韓恢 Liang Nyoh Tien 梁玉田 Tsu Foh Eu 周福安 Van Tsoh Sze 萬竹泉 and Tsu Tuh Eu 周德厚 acted as poll bearers.
The coffin was met by General Yang at the Szecheun Guild where he offered sacrifice to the deceased.
Steps are being taken with a view to re-organising the Volunteer Corps in the City.
It is reported that the employes of bean curd shops will hold a meeting at No.135 Canton Road this afternoon with a view to requesting an increase of wages.
The first of four theatrical performances which are being given for the purpose of raising funds to assist poor revolutionaries who desire to return home took place in the Kiukiang Road theatre last night. The house was crowded.

The following is translation of an extract from the Deutsche Zeitung fur China dated Dec.5th 1918:-
"For the benefit of the German , Austrian-Hungarian prisoners of war in Siberia, a charity fete will be opened on the 15th and 16th December at the Chang Su Ho's gardens. There will be various stalls, Chinese tea houses, restaurants Vienna Cafe's etc etc. Entrance fee $1, children half price. The fete will open at 4 p.m. Tickets are sold at the Club Concordia, and at the Gardens. "
Your Obedient Servant,
McNewick /
Captain Superintendent of Police. Detective Sub Inspector.

Entered and v.d. D. c. b.

刑事调查处
情报官登记册
第 746 号
日期....................

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1918年12月6日

先生：

装有已故蔡锷将军遗体的棺椁于本月5日上午10时从日本抵达，送葬队伍穿过租界，前往位于教堂路的四川会馆。出席葬礼者包括：吴淞的卢永祥将军、上海道尹、兵工厂的参谋军官、外交公署的翻译员、56名美国海军陆战队员、数名中国士兵以及各校学生。唐绍仪、柏文蔚、蔡元培、顾乃庚、韩恢、梁玉田、周福安、万竹泉和周德厚担任扶灵人。

杨将军在四川会馆迎候灵柩，并向死者致祭。

目前正采取措施，旨在重组城内的商团义勇队。

据悉，豆腐店雇员将于今天下午在广东路135号举行会议，旨在要求增加工资。

为资助希望返乡的贫困革命党人而举办的四场戏剧义演中的第一场，昨晚在九江路剧院举行。现场座无虚席。

以下是1918年12月5日《德文新报》（Deutsche Zeitung für China）摘录的译文：

“为造福在西伯利亚的德国及奥匈帝国战俘，慈善游艺会将于12月15日和16日在张叔和花园举行。届时将设有各种摊位、中式茶馆、餐厅、维也纳咖啡馆等。入场费1元，儿童半价。游艺会将于下午4时开始。门票可在协和俱乐部及花园发售。”

您忠实的仆人，
麦克纽威克 /
警司。侦探副督察。

已录入并阅。D. c. b.
